requirements.title: The standard defines five standard intrinsic modules
requirements.source: S16.10.1 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF471.
requirements.definition: The document defines five standard intrinsic modules: a Fortran environment module, three IEEE modules, and an interoperability with C module.

pending.standard-intrinsic-module-set-defined: Source-use inventory plan cross-references the catalogues for ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, IEEE_ARITHMETIC, IEEE_FEATURES, and ISO_C_BINDING; no executable oracle is needed for the prose enumeration.

Processor-dependent numeric values, module extensions, compiler option/version text, team identity, atomic/event behavior, multi-image preconnection, and message text are not asserted.

requirements.title: Standard intrinsic modules are described by their owning clauses
requirements.source: S16.10.1 p2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF471.
requirements.definition: The IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, IEEE_ARITHMETIC, and IEEE_FEATURES modules are described in Clause 17; ISO_C_BINDING is described in Clause 18; the module procedures in 16.10.2 are simple.

pending.ieee-modules-described-in-clause-17: Source-use inventory plan records the clause-17 ownership of IEEE_EXCEPTIONS, IEEE_ARITHMETIC, and IEEE_FEATURES; this packet does not bind clause-17 fixtures.
pending.iso-c-binding-described-in-clause-18: Source-use inventory plan records the clause-18 ownership of ISO_C_BINDING; this packet does not bind clause-18 fixtures.
pending.iso-fortran-env-procedures-simple: Future ISO_FORTRAN_ENV procedure fixtures call COMPILER_OPTIONS and COMPILER_VERSION as ordinary generic module procedures with no specific-name oracle.

requirements.title: Processors may extend standard intrinsic modules with additional public entities
requirements.source: S16.10.1 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: A processor may provide public entities in standard intrinsic modules in addition to those specified by the standard.

pending.standard-intrinsic-module-public-extensi: No portable oracle may require or forbid an extra public entity supplied by a processor; future fixtures must import only standard entity names unless a processor profile documents an extension outside conformance credit.

accounting.rationale: Defines the set and broad purpose of the five standard intrinsic modules.
Cross-references the clauses that own the IEEE and C interoperability modules and states that 16.10.2 module procedures are simple.
Note only; it explains that entities defined in standard intrinsic modules are not themselves intrinsic.
Processor permission to add public entities to standard intrinsic modules.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.10, 16.10.1, 16.10.2 and 16.10.2.1-16.10.2.17 of the intrinsic module ISO_FORTRAN_ENV (batch211). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer with zero findings (16.10.2.7 extraction drift verified visually on pages 472-473); C1603-C1606 were pre-accounted numbered rules with no existing test coverage; atomic, event and team facets are out of scope. Source accounting only.
